name: Four Seasons Tented Camp Golden Triangle
positioning: Luxury tented camp with all-inclusive stays where Thailand, Myanmar and Laos meet, in Chiang Rai
best_for: Travelers who want an all-inclusive tented camp in the Golden Triangle
Guests who want elephant experiences included in their stay

facts.text: The camp has 15 tents and one 2-bedroom Explorer's Lodge, 16 rooms in total.
The camp is in the Golden Triangle, where Thailand, Burma (Myanmar) and Laos meet.
The camp is at the confluence of the Ruak and Mekong Rivers.
Bill Bensley Design is the architect and interior designer.
Tents are reminiscent of 19th-century adventure expeditions with handcrafted furniture, hardwood floors and traditional thatched roofs.
Nong Yao Restaurant serves Thai, Laotian, Burmese and Western cuisine.
Burma Bar is the camp's lounge.
The spa is an open-air platform spa overlooking a jungle valley.

highlights.text: Four Seasons Tented Camp Golden Triangle describes itself as the first all-inclusive Resort for Four Seasons Hotels and Resorts.
Dining experiences are included in your stay.
Breakfast with elephants is a complimentary service.
Elephant bathing is a complimentary service.

considerations.text: The camp is forty-five miles north of downtown Chiang Rai.
The drive from Chiang Rai International Airport to the camp takes 60 minutes by car.
Airport transfers are arranged through the Camp Host, who should be contacted for pricing.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers can be combined with the exclusive perks.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get free Wi-Fi access.
